sharing.title: Share your safety plan
sharing.subtitle: Generate a message, then copy or share it yourself. Generating is not sending.
sharing.trusted.title: Trusted contact
sharing.trusted.body: The person who should know your route and expected return. Details stay on this device.
sharing.contactHint: Saved on this device and included in generated messages.
sharing.contact.saved: Contact details saved on this device.
sharing.notice.title: Trip notice
sharing.notice.body: A message in Kazakh and Russian with an optional translation into your interface language.
sharing.messageLanguageHint: The trip notice is always generated in Kazakh and Russian. English is added as a translation when English is selected.
sharing.emptyPreview: Generate a message to see the preview.
sharing.copied: Message copied. It has not been sent.
sharing.copyManual: Automatic copying is unavailable. Select the message text and copy it manually. Nothing has been sent.
sharing.shareUnsupported: Native sharing is not available in this browser. Copy the message instead.
sharing.shareUnsupportedCopied: Native sharing is not available. The message was copied instead — it has not been sent.
sharing.shareUnsupportedManual: Native sharing is not available. Copy the message manually. Nothing has been sent.
sharing.shareOpened: The share dialog closed. Delivery is not confirmed.
sharing.shareFailed: Sharing did not open. Copy the message instead. Nothing has been sent.
sharing.downloaded: Text file downloaded. It has not been sent.
sharing.downloadFailed: The text file could not be downloaded. Copy the message instead.
sharing.email.opened: Opening your email app with a draft. It has not been delivered.
sharing.email.note: Opening the draft does not send it. Review the recipients and send it yourself.
sharing.generatedVsSent: This is a generated draft. Dala Safe does not send messages, email or SMS.
sharing.officialHint: Links open external official sites. Availability and content are controlled by those sites.
sharing.calendar.title: Return reminder (.ics)
sharing.calendar.body: Download a calendar file with alarms before departure and before the expected return. Reminder behaviour depends on your calendar app.
sharing.calendar.limits: Some calendar clients ignore alarms or apply their own limits. Do not rely on this reminder as your only safety measure.
sharing.calendar.alarms: Includes two alarms (departure check and return check).
sharing.message.trusted.intro: I am sharing my trip plan with you for safety.
sharing.message.trusted.ask: Please keep this plan. If I do not return by the expected time, try to contact me and follow the safety plan we agreed on.
sharing.message.notice.heading: Trip notice (not an official trip registration)
sharing.message.email.intro: This email draft contains a summary of my trip plan.
sharing.message.email.subject: Dala Safe trip plan: {name} — {destination}
sharing.message.trip.name: Trip: {name}
sharing.message.contact.name: Trusted contact: {name}
sharing.message.checklist: Checklist: {done} of {total} items done; {remaining} required item(s) remaining.
sharing.message.disclaimer: Generated only — not delivered. This is not an official trip registration. Dala Safe does not send messages or email; you must send this message yourself.
